title: populus nigra var. virginiana
intro: Populus nigra var. virginiana, commonly known as Black Cottonwood or Fremont's Cottonwood, is a deciduous tree native to the western United States and Canada. It is valued for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating digestive issues due to its ability to act as a demulcent, soothing and protecting the mucous membranes. The health benefits of Populus nigra var. virginiana include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
